categories.title: Features
list: Mirrors only the edit you made, so asymmetric detail elsewhere on the model is left alone
Move, rotate and scale in vertex, edge and face selection modes
Extrude, including the new side walls and the matching face on the other side
Mirror across X, Y or Z, set from a dropdown in the toolbar
Two mirror planes: Global uses world zero, Local uses the element's own pivot
Rotated elements work under Local, where the plane rotates with the element
A translucent guide shows where the mirror plane actually is
Edits that cannot be mirrored safely are skipped with a message naming the cause

categories.title: Known limits
list: Loop cut, knife and deletion are not mirrored
Extrusions landing on or across the mirror plane are skipped, since nothing is welded at the seam
Mirroring happens inside one element, so rigged limb pairs are not paired up
New faces copy the source face's UVs; the UVs themselves are not mirrored
Mesh elements only, and Blockbench's built-in Mirror Modeling has to be off
